terms.rationale: On the call the vendor said 21% is the floor on treats. That still leaves treats short of target, so the cost asks above are the real lever.
The vendor already conceded 30 days on the call, subject to written order confirmation. We pay on 45 as standard; hold 30 as the floor.
At MOQ 800 the shortlist carries 176 days of cover. The vendor agreed to 500 in total on the call; hold that.
Agreed on the call for the launch month, to be spent on sponsored listings and sampling.
We asked for sale-or-return after 90 days and the vendor declined because treats have short shelf life. Accept; no concession needed from us.

counter_offer.email_draft: Hi Priya, thank you for the call. To close: we can work with 30-day payment terms, a first order of 500 units, Rs 50,000 launch marketing and a 5% launch discount for 30 days, as discussed. The open item is unit cost. To reach our margin target we need MW-T01 at ₹121.25 and MW-T02 at ₹105.63, and we need you to send the actual cost for MW-T03, MW-L01 and MW-L04, which are blank in your sheet. If 21% is truly your floor on treats, tell us which SKUs you can move and we will prioritise those. Please confirm in writing this week. Regards, Category Team.
